task_prompt: Please draft a comment for Jira ticket ITSM-4491 summarizing the root cause of the HR payroll server outage and confirming that network-level isolation has been implemented. Include the timestamp of the fix and the affected subsystem.

  "comments": [
    {
      "author": "daqwan.morris",
      "body": "Preliminary log analysis shows repeated failed login attempts for user t.reynolds@summitlogistics.com from IP 185.199.108.153 (associated with Spokeo) starting 2024-03-27 22:10 UTC.       "author": "rui.guo",

    }
  ],
